online_steps: Download and open 'MERA RATION' mobile application (available in 13 languages).
Enter Aadhaar number or Ration Card number to check active entitlement and nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS).
Use the app to locate POS-enabled Fair Price Shops in the destination state/district.
offline_steps: Visit any Fair Price Shop (FPS) with ePoS device anywhere in India.
Quote Aadhaar number or Ration Card number to the FPS dealer.
Perform biometric (fingerprint or iris) authentication on the ePoS device.
Collect entitled full or partial food grains at central issue prices.

online_steps: Visit the official portal maandhan.in or self-enrollment section on e-Shram portal.
Enter Aadhaar number and verify using OTP sent to registered mobile.
Fill applicant details, unorganised worker occupation, and bank IFSC.
Set up bank auto-debit mandate and make the initial monthly contribution online.
offline_steps: Visit the nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) along with Aadhaar card and Savings Bank Passbook.
VLE (Village Level Entrepreneur) enters details and takes biometric authentication.
System calculates monthly contribution (Rs 55 to Rs 200 based on age).
Pay the first installment in cash at CSC; system generates PMSYM Card immediately.
processing_time: Instant card generation upon first contribution

online_steps: Visit official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) -> Farmers Corner -> 'New Farmer Registration'.
Select Rural Farmer Registration or Urban Farmer Registration.
Enter Aadhaar Number and Mobile Number, select State, and verify OTP.
Fill personal, bank, and land details (survey/khata number, dag/khasra number, land size in hectares).
Complete mandatory e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or facial recognition via PM-KISAN Mobile App.
offline_steps: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Patwari / Revenue Officer / Nodal Agriculture Officer.
Submit land records, Aadhaar, and bank passbook for verification.
processing_time: Approval by State/District Nodal Officer within 15-30 days
fees: Free on portal; standard CSC assistance charges apply for CSC visits

online_steps: Register on National Portal for PM Surya Ghar (pmsuryaghar.gov.in) by selecting State, Distribution Company (DISCOM), and Consumer Account Number.
Apply for Rooftop Solar installation by submitting roof area and sanctioned load details.
Wait for DISCOM feasibility approval online.
Select a registered vendor and get the rooftop solar plant installed.
Submit plant details and apply for net meter inspection.
Upon DISCOM inspection and commissioning certificate generation, submit bank account details for direct subsidy disbursement.
offline_steps: Net meter physical inspection and installation by DISCOM field team.
processing_time: Subsidy credited directly to bank account within 30 days of commissioning
fees: Application online is free; plant cost net of subsidy payable to vendor

online_steps: Access PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or PM SVANidhi mobile app.
Enter mobile number and verify via OTP.
Select vendor category: (A) Vendors with Vending Card/LoR, (B) Vendors left out of survey, (C) Surrounding rural vendors.
Upload KYC documents and select preferred lending institution / bank.
Submit loan application for 1st tranche (up to Rs 10,000).
offline_steps: Visit nearest CSC, Municipal Corporation office, or bank branch for application submission.
Collect Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC) if not possessing ID card.
processing_time: Loan sanctioned typically within 7-14 working days

online_steps: Artisan visits nearest CSC for Aadhaar-based biometric registration on PM Vishwakarma Portal.
Three-tier verification: Stage 1 Gram Panchayat / ULB verification; Stage 2 District Implementation Committee; Stage 3 Screening Committee.
Upon approval, download PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card.
Undergo 5-7 days basic skill training (Rs 500/day stipend).
Receive Rs 15,000 toolkit digital e-voucher and apply for Enterprise Development Loan (Tranche 1: Rs 1 Lakh at 5% interest).
offline_steps: Physical biometric verification and hands-on skill training at designated training centers.

online_steps: Visit pmuy.gov.in portal, select LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).
Submit online application form with Aadhaar and family ration card details.
offline_steps: Visit nearest LPG distributor showroom.
Submit filled application form along with Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, and 14-point declaration.
Distributor verifies eligibility against OMC de-duplication database.
Receive LPG cylinder, pressure regulator, hose pipe, and stove.
processing_time: Connection released within 7-10 days of document verification
fees: Free security deposit, free first cylinder and stove assistance

online_steps: Check Job Card status and muster roll payment on nrega.nic.in portal.
offline_steps: Adult members of rural household submit application (oral or written) for registration to Gram Panchayat.
Gram Panchayat verifies local residence and household adulthood within 14 days.
Gram Panchayat issues Job Card bearing photographs of all adult members free of cost.
Worker submits written application demanding employment specifying dates and duration.
Gram Panchayat / Block Programme Officer allots wage employment within 15 days, or pays statutory unemployment allowance.
processing_time: Job card issued within 15 days; employment provided within 15 days of demand

online_steps: Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or state social welfare department portal.
Navigate to 'Apply Online' and choose the relevant pension component (IGNOAPS / IGNWPS / IGNDPS).
Enter Aadhaar number and complete e-KYC authentication.
Upload scanned copies of Age Proof, BPL ration card, and bank account passbook details.
Submit the application and note down the generated Application Reference Number for tracking.
offline_steps: Obtain the physical NSAP application form from the local Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), or Urban Local Body (Municipality/Corporation).
Fill out the applicant details and attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, Age Certificate, BPL Proof, and Bank Passbook.
Submit the completed application form to the designated Social Welfare Officer / BDO office.
Undergo field verification conducted by the Gram Panchayat or designated local verification officer.
Upon verification and sanction, receive monthly pension directly disbursed to the linked bank/post office account via DBT.
processing_time: 30-45 working days from submission to sanction
fees: Free of cost / No application fee

online_steps: Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or your state social welfare department portal.
Select 'Apply Online' and choose 'Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)'.
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC authentication.
Upload age proof document (showing age 60+) and BPL ration card/income certificate.
Enter bank account details linked to Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer.
Submit application and note down tracking reference number.
offline_steps: Collect IGNOAPS application form from Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / Municipality.
Attach Aadhaar card, age proof certificate, BPL proof, and bank passbook photocopy.
Submit form to Social Welfare Officer or Block Development Office.
Verification is conducted by local administration before sanction.
fees: Free of cost / No application fee

online_steps: Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or state social welfare department portal.
Select 'Apply Online' and choose 'Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)'.
Upload death certificate of husband, age proof (40+), and BPL proof.
Provide bank account details for DBT pension transfer.
offline_steps: Obtain application form from Gram Panchayat / BDO office.
Attach death certificate of husband, age proof, BPL card, and bank passbook.
Submit to Social Welfare Officer / BDO office.
fees: Free of cost / No application fee

online_steps: Visit the NSAP portal or state social welfare portal.
Select 'Apply Online' -> 'Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)'.
Upload disability certificate (80%+ severe/multiple disability or UDID card) and BPL proof.
Provide Aadhaar and bank account details.
offline_steps: Obtain application form from BDO / Gram Panchayat / District Social Welfare Office.
Attach disability certificate / UDID card, BPL ration card, and bank passbook.
Submit to BDO or District Disability Rehabilitation Centre.
fees: Free of cost / No application fee

online_steps: Visit the NSAP portal or state social welfare portal.
Select 'Apply Online' -> 'National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)'.
Upload death certificate of breadwinner (died aged 18-59) and BPL proof.
Provide head of household bank account details.
offline_steps: Obtain NFBS application form from Gram Panchayat / BDO office.
Attach breadwinner's death certificate, age verification, BPL card, and bank details.
Submit to BDO / District Social Welfare Officer within designated period.
fees: Free of cost / No application fee

online_steps: Visit state Food and Civil Supplies / Social Welfare portal.
Select 'Apply for Annapurna Scheme'.
Upload age proof (60+) and declaration of non-receipt of pension under IGNOAPS.
Select designated Fair Price Shop (FPS) for food grain collection.
offline_steps: Obtain Annapurna Scheme form from Gram Panchayat or Taluk Supply Office / Ration Office.
Attach age proof (60+), BPL ration card, and non-pensioner certificate.
Submit to local Food & Civil Supplies Inspector or BDO office.
Upon sanction, an Annapurna special ration card is issued for 10 kg free grains monthly.
fees: Free of cost / No application fee
